intro: Our Dr. Jogy mattress is built for deep, restorative sleep—with ergonomic support, plush comfort, and a design that takes care of your spine, night after night.

features.title: Ergonomic support for restful sleep
features.text: Designed to align your spine and ease pressure points, it gives your body the balanced support it needs for truly restful sleep.

features.title: Breathable fabric cover
features.text: The airy fabric cover helps regulate temperature and keeps you cool and fresh through the night, no matter the season.

features.title: Durable and long-lasting build
features.text: Built to withstand daily use, Dr. Jogy stays firm and comfortable—offering long-lasting support you can count on.

features.title: Sleep as you like
features.text: Whether you sleep on your back, side, or stomach, this mattress offers a firm surface that suits all positions comfortably.

features.title: Dual Side Usable
features.text: Enjoy lasting comfort from both sides—flip it over anytime for extended use and fresh feel without compromising on support.

features.title: Balanced comfort
features.text: Combines firm support with a hint of softness—perfect if you want structure without sacrificing a bit of plushness.

name: Dr Jogy King Bed Foam Mattress 72 X 70 X 5 Inches
